notes: Fixes random late shots caused by a stale tracking reference after the detector briefly loses the meter and a dim HUD/court feature lingers near the old spot. Fixes false detections from bright white objects (court lines/HUD) that could steal or delay a shot. PlayStation/DualSense controller fix for the Remote Play bridge (flick now works correctly on PS4/PS5 pads, not just Xbox). No changes to the GPC this update.
